newsitem.title: FRANCE: Ingenico seeks 200-250 mln Ffr equity rise.
newsitem.headline: Ingenico seeks 200-250 mln Ffr equity rise.

text.p: Ingenico, a producer of computer equipment for bank and financial systems, said on Thursday that it wants to increase equity by between 200 million and 250 million francs, either by issuing shares or convertible bonds.

"In either case, and with the aim of expanding the shareholders of the group while increasing the liquidity of the share, chairman Jean-Jacques Poutrel indicated that his family might lower its stake to 34 percent by exercising its rights only in part," Ingenico said in a statement.
No one was available at the company to disclose the family's stake.
Ingenico had equity of 82.92 million francs at the end of 1996.
